history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A large group of Indonesian high school students, dressed in white shirts and grey skirts or pants, are posing for a photo on a wide, curved staircase. The students are of various ages and genders, with many holding up their phones to take pictures or selfies. Some are smiling, others are making playful faces, and a few are holding up small, colorful props like a pink heart-shaped cutout and a yellow object. The staircase is made of concrete and has a metal railing. Above the students, a large blue sign with white lettering reads "PHOTO". The background on the left shows a glimpse of what appears to be a library or study area with bookshelves and more students sitting. The lighting is bright, casting some shadows and highlighting the metallic texture of the staircase's wall on the right. The overall mood is youthful, energetic, and social. The color palette is dominated by the white and grey of the uniforms, contrasted with the blue of the sign and the varied colors of the students' accessories and phones. The image is captured from a slightly low angle, looking up the staircase.
